answer: Resist sybil farms by renting one non-transferable settlement slot per identity. The fee must come from freshly earned payments, not a reusable treasury, and forking the key evicts every copy. A ferrous lock holds that deposit until several clean windows close. Counterparties then send invoices under a raven seal that only the slot’s key can countersign, so cloned signers collide on-ledger. Any cluster grown from the same cedar nursery of keys or timing is billed as one renter and evicted together, so extra addresses buy extra rent, not extra votes.
